features.title: Read one stored JSON record without loading the whole unit
features.summary: Owned fork of the native JSON storage backend: the per-record unit additionally answers synchronous per-record reads (listKeysSync, getRecordSync, getGlobalSync) so the owned storage-domain fork can hydrate one record on first read instead of materializing every record at open. The on-disk format, the atomic publish protocol, the legacy whole-unit bootstrap, and every write path are upstream byte-for-byte; the sync reads apply the same parse and version rules the open-time loadAll applies.

configuration.constraints: Absolute directory holding one `<unit>.json` file or `<unit>/` tree per unit; restated from the stock row because a patch replaces whole configs.

failureModes: A record document that is malformed or stamped with an unaccepted version reads as absent, exactly as loadAll reports it.
A sync read after close rejects with the backend's `closed` StorageError.
Every other behaviour is the pinned upstream code; drift is checked with scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs.

verification.testName: indexes stored document keys without reading a record
reports a foreign document as absent, exactly like loadAll does
reads a record the stock backend wrote and writes one it reads back

telemetry.reason: In-process file reads under the opener's existing request span: a storage unit has no network, socket, or job of its own.
